items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Jerônimo Monteiro (ES) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Nov 19, 16:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
